Dear Ms. Whitfield,

I am writing to request approval for a conference trip. The Strata Data Conference runs from March 9 to March 11 in San Jose. The total cost comes to $3,180, including the early registration fee of $1,450, flights, and three nights at the venue hotel.

Two of the sessions cover the streaming architecture we plan to adopt next year, and I will share notes with the team on my return.

Thank you for considering it.

Best regards,
Noah Bergstrom
